featured_reviews.name: Gurvinder Pal Singh Kalra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Undoubtedly the Jewel in the crown of the culinary delights of the bustling food scene of Mahim - Raafae’s Dastarkhwan is one of the newest entrants.

We had the delight and pleasure of meeting and getting recommendations from Chef Asim personally , who has mastered the art of dishing out the delectable cuisine from the rustic bye lanes of Old Delhi now serving to the mumbai palate.

We started off with a most delicious mutton Halim which was most succulent and delicately flavoured . This was followed by a sizzling of Kebab’s consisting of the tenderest mutton and chicken kakori kebab and softest mutton tundey kebab to be ever served in Mahim .
This was followed by a delicious mutton Nihari with tandoori roti leaving absolutely no place for me to try some of the delicious desserts and mock tails on offer .

The establishment is located on main Lady Jamshedji Road just besides the choti dargha and has a fair ambiance with outdoor seating should you choose to dine so.

Place a very hygienic and it’s evident that the food has been prepared with much care and love.

Pricing is very attractive considering the superlative quality of the food served . A definitive must try and surely you will love to visit again and again .

All best wishes to the fantastic team here ! Keep up the good work !

featured_reviews.name: Noor Sayeed Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mahim's culinary scene has a new contender: Burger Lab. This recently opened burger joint is already making waves with its impressive selection of high-quality burgers.

We had the pleasure of trying a variety of their offerings, including the signature Smash Burger, Fish Fillet Burger, Chicken BBQ Burger, Chicken Zinger Burger, and a side of fries. The fries were crispy and well-seasoned, a perfect accompaniment to the burgers.

While all the burgers were delicious, the Smash Burger undoubtedly stole the show. The perfectly smashed patty, with its crispy edges and juicy center, was a flavor explosion. I opted for the single patty, but I highly recommend trying the double or even triple patty for an even more satisfying experience.

The Fish Fillet Burger and Chicken BBQ Burger were also excellent, showcasing a well-balanced blend of flavors and textures. The Chicken Zinger Burger was a classic done right, with a flavorful and juicy chicken fillet.

Dine-in options are limited, but the stall provides a few sitting tables, making it a decent spot to enjoy your meal. The service was quick and efficient, despite the busy atmosphere.

Burger Lab offers incredible value for money. The prices are very reasonable, making it an excellent choice for a satisfying and affordable meal. The friendly and helpful staff further enhances the overall dining experience.

Overall, Burger Lab is a must-visit for any burger enthusiast. This newcomer is already proving itself to be a strong contender in the neighborhood's burger scene.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We tried the Chicken Manchow Soup, the Chicken Cheese Kurkure Momos, and the Chicken Chilly Fried Rice and every dish was an absolute delight. The Manchow was flavourful and comforting, the kurkure momos were perfectly crunchy with a rich, cheesy filling, and the fried rice tasted authentic, delicious, and generously loaded.

This place is a true hidden gem. One must visit this restaurant to experience first-hand the goodness they bring to the table. A solid 5-star rating from us!

Highly recommended for anyone craving great taste without compromise.

featured_reviews.name: Devang Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this Mughlai restaurant and had a genuinely satisfying experience. The starters set the tone for the meal — the Mutton Seekh was absolutely A1. Juicy, well-seasoned, and perfectly cooked, it had that ideal balance of spice and tenderness that’s hard to find.

The Malai Chicken, however, was a bit on the tougher side. The flavor was good, but the texture could definitely be improved to make it softer and creamier — the way Malai Tikka is meant to be.

Apart from that, the main courses were rich, aromatic, and full of traditional Mughlai depth. The service was warm, and the overall ambiance made the dining experience even better.

With just a little improvement in the Malai Chicken, this place has all the potential to be a go-to Mughlai spot.
